title: Atomic git commit after every file edit
body: After every Write or Edit tool call that modifies a file, immediately run a Bash 'git add <file> && git commit' covering only that file before moving to the next edit.
example: Edit(src/a.ts) → Bash(git add src/a.ts && git commit) → Edit(src/b.ts) → Bash(git add src/b.ts && git commit).
